verses.tl: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tuqaddimoo bayna yadayi Allaahi wa rasoolihi wattaqoo Allaaha innallaaha samee'un aleem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tarfa'oo aswaatakum fawqa sawtin-nabiyyi wa laa tajharoo lahu bil-qawli kajahri ba'dikum liba'din an tahbata a'maalukum wa antum laa tash'uroon
Innal-ladheena yaghuddoona aswaatahum inda rasooli Allaahi ulaa'ikal-ladheena imtahana Allaahu quloobahum lit-taqwaa lahum maghfiratun wa ajrun azeem
Innal-ladheena yunaadoonaka min waraa'il-hujuraati aktharuhum laa ya'qiloon
Wa law annahum sabaroo hattaa takhruja ilayhim lakaana khayran lahum Wallaahu ghafoorun Raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in jaa'akum faasiqun binaba'iin fatabayyanoo an tuseeboo qawman bijahaalatin fatusbihoo alaa maa fa-altum naadimeen

Wa'lamoo anna feekum rasoola Allaahi law yutee'ukum fee katheerin minal-amri la-anittum wa laakinna Allaaha habbaba ilaykumul-eemaana wa zayyanahu fee quloobikum wa karraha ilaykumul-kufra wal-fusooqa wal-isyaana ulaa'ika humur-raashidoon
Fadlan mina Allaahi wa ni'matan Wallaahu aleemun hakeem

Wa in taa'ifataani minal-mu'mineena iqtataloo fa-aslihoo baynahumaa fa-in baghat ihdaahumaa alal-ukhraa faqaatilul-latee tabghee hattaa tafee'a ilaa amrillaahi fa-in fa-at fa-aslihoo baynahumaa bil-adli wa aqsitoo innallaaha yuhibbul-muqsiteen
Innamal-mu'minoona ikhwatun fa-aslihoo bayna akhawaykum wattaqoo Allaaha la-allakum turhamoon

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa yaskhar qawmun min qawmin asaa an yakoonoo khayran minhum wa laa nisaa'un min nisaa'in asaa an yakunna khayran minhunna wa laa talmizoo anfusakum wa laa tanaabazoo bil-alqaabi bi'sal-aismul-fusooqu ba'dal-eemaani wa man lam yatub fa-ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo ijtaniboo katheeran minaz-zanni inna ba'daz-zanni ithmun wa laa tajassasoo wa laa yaghtab ba'dukum ba'dan ayuhibbu ahadukum an ya'kula lahma akheehi maytan fakarihtumoohu wattaqoo Allaaha innallaaha tawwaabun Raheem
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu innaa khalaqnaakum min dhakarin wa unthaa wa ja'alnaakum shu'ooban wa qabaa'ila lita'aarafoo inna akramakum indallaahi atqaakum innallaaha aleemun khabeer

Qaalatil-a'raabu aamannaa qul lam tu'minoo wa laakin qooloo aslamnaa wa lammaa yadkhulil-eemaanu fee quloobikum wa in tutee'oo Allaaha wa rasoolahu laa yalitkum min a'maalikum shay'an innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Innamal-mu'minoonal-ladheena aamanoo Billaahi wa rasoolihi thumma lam yartaaboo wa jaahadoo bi-amwaalihim wa anfusihim fee sabeelillaahi ulaa'ika humus-saadiqoon
Qul atu'allimoona Allaaha bideenikum Wallaahu ya'lamu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi Wallaahu bikulli shay'in aleem
Yamunnoona alayka an aslamoo qul laa tamunnoo alayya islaamakum bali Allaahu yamunnu alaykum an hadaakum lil-eemaani in kuntum saadiqeen
Innallaaha ya'lamu ghaybas-samaawaati wal-ardi Wallaahu baseerun bimaa ta'maloon
